is_anopheles.evidence: Page 2: 'A total of 3962 female An. gambiae s.l. mosquitoes were captured... A subsample (n = 181) was selected for molecular form identification, of which 68% (123/181) and 31% (56/181) were determined to be An. coluzzii... and An. gambiae s.s.'

reports_target_markers.evidence: Target markers genotyped and reported include Vgsc L1014F (L995F), N1575Y (N1570Y), I1527T, and Ace-1 G119S (G280S) (Tables 1, 2, 3, 4).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Tables 1-4 provide detailed genotype counts (homozygote mutation RR, heterozygote RS, wild type SS) and sample sizes for An. gambiae s.l. across six villages.

african_field_population.evidence: Page 7: 'Mosquito collections were undertaken in six villages in the Maferinyah sub-prefecture, Forecariah Prefecture... in Southwest Guinea... between 22nd June and 17th July 2017.'

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical field and laboratory study reporting original bioassay, parity, infection, and genotyping data.

sub_country_location.evidence: Page 7: Six villages specified in Maferinyah sub-prefecture, Forecariah Prefecture, Guinea (Fandie, Madinagbe, Maferinyah Centre I, Moribayah, Senguelen, Yindi).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Page 7: 'Sampling was conducted between 22nd June and 17th July 2017.'

duplicate_risk.evidence: Original field collection performed in June-July 2017 specifically for this study.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts, sample sizes, allele frequencies, and bioassay parameters are fully detailed within the main text and Tables 1-4.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated pyrethroid and carbamate resistance, parity, Plasmodium infection, and resistance marker frequencies (Vgsc L1014F, N1575Y, I1527T, and Ace-1 G119S) in field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.s. and Anopheles coluzzii across six villages in Forecariah Prefecture, Guinea, in 2017. Genotype counts and allele frequencies are broken down by site and bioassay survival status.
